purpose: Test whether the observed CS-ECF gain is explained only by its lower switching frequency or candidate mix.
matching_rule: Within each checkpoint and sequence, generate a random policy with the same number of switched images and the same multiset of CDF, PIAFusion, and SPGFusion labels as CS-ECF. Shuffle image positions and candidate labels independently from detector confidence.
estimand: Equal-group mean AP50 relative to visible, averaged equally within each sequence and then over the six final checkpoints.
inference_boundary: Conditional randomization summary over the observed three sequences and six checkpoints. It is not a cross-scene confidence guarantee.
